name: Words and the tongue
text: The power of words, guarding the tongue, gossip and slander, speaking kindly and little.

Such, for example, are the terms democracy, socialism, equality, liberty, &c., whose meaning is so vague that bulky volumes do not suffice to precisely fix it.
